title: New Life and Vampire
overview: Academically-challenged Tsukune suddenly finds himself enrolled at a mysterious high school with a shocking secret! His life may never be the same after an encounter with the mesmerizing Moka!

title: Succubus and a Vampire
overview: Moka’s obvious affection for Tsukune earns him the wrath of the school’s male students. As if that weren’t bad enough, a popular succubus is determined to seduce the poor boy!

title: Witchling and a Vampire
overview: A mischievous young witch stirs up trouble between Moka and Tsukune, but will a ghastly confrontation with a trio of lizardmen change her outlook on love?

title: Farewell and a Vampire
overview: The boys who make up Moka’s fan club decide it’s time to get rid of Tsukune, who is mortified that his puny stature makes him unable to protect his special lady friends!

title: School Swimsuits and a Vampire
overview: Tsukune’s interest in the school swimming club is a big problem for Moka. It seems water has a strange effect on vampires, and a quick dip in the pool could sap her powers!

title: Newspaper Club and a Vampire
overview: There’s a rumor going around that Tsukune is the creep sneaking glances at other girls. Kurumu and Yukari get to the heart of the matter to clear his name.

title: Snow Girl and a Vampire
overview: Tsukune attracts yet another fangirl in Mizore. How can a girl express her feelings with troublesome teachers threatening expulsion? It’s up to Tsukune to quell the beast in Moka, or things could get messy!

title: Math and a Vampire
overview: Private lessons from Tsukune’s seductive math teacher start subtracting from his personality. At odds with the situation, Moka’s got to snap him out of it before the hungry mentor really sinks her teeth in.

title: Summer Break and a Vampire
overview: Summer vacation calls the Newspaper Club to a beach in the human world. Yukari is tempted to ditch school and join Ruby, a witch living in a coveted sunflower field nearby. Trouble brews as Tsukune attempts to break the spell.

title: Sunflowers and a Vampire
overview: Ruby explains the plight of the sunflower fields to Yukari’s rescuers, who prove to be a curiously kind bunch. All seems to be kosher after the confusion the night before, until a forbidden spell is unleashed.

title: New Term and a Vampire
overview: Summer vacation is over and the Newspaper Club is trying to get back to work. Unfortunately, they find their efforts complicated by the meddlesome Public Safety Commission.

title: Security Committee and a Vampire
overview: The Newspaper Club’s attempt to expose the corruption of the Public Safety Commission backfires in a big way when Tsukune is arrested and accused of being human!

title: Tsukune and a Vampire
overview: Tsukune’s life is on the line! Moka makes an amazing attempt to save him, and finds an unlikely ally in her mission to prevent his execution.
